name: Phantom Fang
text:
This +1 standard-grade cold iron kama is shrouded in spectral mist, leaving behind shimmering afterimages when swung.

Activate—Phantom Dodge r

Frequency once per day

Trigger You're targeted by a ranged attack, and you're aware of the attacker

---
Effect Your body becomes temporarily shrouded in mist, causing you to become Concealed against the triggering attack.
